Implementations receive the standard AES Announcement object and must return the resulting Announcement object.</description><example><![CDATA[var CustomAESAnnouncementExtension = Class.create();

CustomAESAnnouncementExtension.prototype =
    Object.extendsObject(AESAnnouncementExtension, {

        transformAnnouncement: function(announcement, gr, options) {

            announcement.custom_field = gr.getValue('custom_field');

        },
